  (15) Description of Requirement  

 The National Institutes of Health (NIH), Office of the Director, Office of Acquisitions, intends to negotiate and issue a firm-fixed-price purchase order on a sole-source basis to Revolutionary Solutions, LLC for Metabolic Kitchen Cook Services supporting the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK). 

 NIDDK’s Obesity and Diabetes Clinical Research Section (ODCRS), Phoenix Epidemiology and Clinical Research Branch (PECRB), conducts inpatient and outpatient studies involving energy balance, weight gain, obesity, and type 2 diabetes. 

 These studies depend on precisely controlled diets, accurate food measurements, and consistent preparation methods. The Metabolic Kitchen prepares and delivers meals in accordance with established research protocols and documents dietary information used in research analyses. 

 The Government requires two full-time qualified cooks to support the continued operation of the Metabolic Kitchen and maintain continuity of services for ongoing clinical research. 

 Services shall be performed in accordance with  Attachment 1, Statement of Work (SOW) , and include: 

 
	 Preparing, cooking, assembling, and labeling foods, fluids, and special liquid formulas for controlled diets, test meals, and specialized feedings. 
	 Following standardized recipes, menus, preparation methods, and research protocols. 
	 Precisely weighing and measuring ingredients and portioning foods to meet prescribed serving sizes and nutrient requirements. 
	 Coordinating food preparation to meet scheduled meal-service times. 
	 Evaluating food quality throughout preparation. 
	 Operating kitchen equipment safely and maintaining sanitary preparation, storage, and work areas. 
	 Recording food temperatures and properly labeling, dating, storing, and rotating foods. 
	 Stocking study vending machines and refrigerators according to designated food lists. 
	 Delivering and retrieving participant meal trays. 
	 Weighing and documenting uneaten food and returned food packaging. 
	 Coordinating with nutrition personnel, research staff, and research participants as required by the SOW. 
 

 Attachment 1 establishes the complete performance requirements. 

  (16) Basis for Intended Sole-Source Award  

 Revolutionary Solutions, LLC currently provides Metabolic Kitchen Cook Services supporting ODCRS’s ongoing clinical research. Its assigned cooks have demonstrated experience preparing protocol-specific diets, performing precise food measurements, maintaining research documentation, and coordinating with dietitians and research personnel as protocol requirements change. 

 The requirement extends beyond general food preparation. Personnel must consistently prepare precisely measured meals, maintain accurate portioning, and document food intake and leftovers in accordance with established research protocols. Errors or inconsistencies could affect dietary measurements and the integrity of ongoing research data. 

 Transitioning to another contractor could require recruiting, onboarding, and training personnel while maintaining daily meal services for enrolled research participants. Interruptions or errors during this process could disrupt scheduled research activities and compromise continuity of dietary data. The proposed award would preserve the specialized operational knowledge of the currently assigned cooks and support consistent execution of these protocol-sensitive services. 

 The Government will consider timely quotations from other responsible sources demonstrating the ability to satisfy the complete requirement, including qualified staffing, accurate protocol execution, readiness for the required start date, and continuity of daily services. Responses should explain how the source would manage transition activities while maintaining required performance without disrupting ongoing research. 

  (17) Staffing, Schedule, and Qualifications  

 The contractor shall have qualified personnel available to begin performance on the start date established in the resulting award, which is anticipated to be January 1, 2027. 

 The contractor shall provide two full-time cooks. Each cook shall work no more than 40 hours per week, excluding overtime approved in advance. 

 Required coverage may include early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays. The contractor shall maintain staffing coverage during personnel absences as required by the SOW. 

 Up to 100 overtime hours per cook, for a combined maximum of 200 overtime hours during each 12-month contract period, may be required. Overtime requires advance approval in accordance with the resulting award.
